integrity: The proof establishes every-field classification; finite-field checks for q=2,3 are supplementary and do not constitute an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only embedded linear subspaces in the four-by-four nilradical are classified. No higher-order, automorphism-orbit, or nonreduced-scheme statement is made. Historical priority remains provisional because the 2008 preserver full text was inaccessible.
title: Maximal square-zero linear subalgebras of the four-by-four nilradical
